scientific_integrity: Independent mathematical validation not performed. A standalone enumerator corroborates 18 finite configurations; the unrestricted proof is given separately.
scientific_limitations: Complete labeled-image-type counts for \(C_{p^2}\oplus C_{p^b}\), every prime \(p\) and integer \(b\ge 2\). No orbit count, larger-group extension, or literature-uniqueness certification. Hall-polynomial methods could independently imply these formulas.
title: Complete image spectra of square-zero endomorphisms of two-level finite abelian groups
